name: Resampling Point Shading
aliases: New Volume Rendering Method for Explosion Fields
definition: A method to improve shading accuracy by applying the lighting model directly to resampling points using interpolated normal vectors and opacity-weighted color interpolation, avoiding Mach band artifacts and interface color confusion.
summary: Resampling Point Shading improves volume rendering accuracy by calculating lighting directly at resampling points using interpolated normals, avoiding artifacts common in vertex-based methods.
